## Checklist

- [ ] Scope is small and clear.
- [ ] Sources and external licenses are recorded where needed.
- [ ] Any simulated data or AI-assisted content is identified.
- [ ] No credentials or private personal health data are included.
- [ ] A teammate has been requested to review, where available.
